_: THE REGISTER OF THE WORK. Every movement, every chapter, its form and its source. read.html walks this. probes/probe-production.mjs measures against it. Nothing else is authoritative.
_why: Until 20 August the outline lived in four planning documents and none of them was read by anything. BOOK.json knew eight chapters — all of Movement IV — and the movements existed only in prose nobody parsed. That is how forty-one briefs came to have eight linked: WITHOUT A REGISTER, COPIES ACCUMULATE, each correct about a different day.
_law: No chapter publishes before the thing it describes.
title: The Book of the Dead
subtitle: How this machine was built, written against the machine
through: We built to spec in order to unlock the gates.
_through_note: A spell is named and numbered and invoked at a particular gate, and calling the wrong one does nothing at all. Every register in this system is one of those invocations. A green lamp with nothing behind it is a spell miscalled: the gate does not open, and nothing tells you.
plateNote: This band was read from the live system at the hour of writing. It has not been updated since.

forms.prose: No apparatus. Nothing was measurable yet — a chapter about June cannot show a live number and will not pretend to.
forms.field: A chronicle written during the days it describes. A primary source. It must not be smoothed.
forms.apparatus: Five bands — SPELL · MECHANISM · PRIMER · PLATE · ROADMAP. By this point the system could be READ.

_turn: THE TURN BETWEEN THE FORMS IS NOT A CHANGE OF STYLE. IT IS THE MOMENT THE THING BECAME MEASURABLE.

illustration.narrative: unillustrated — a man face down on shingle speaking byte parity is better in a reader's head than on a screen
illustration.mechanism: diagrams where the subject is spatial
illustration.plate: READ, NEVER DRAWN. If a chart in a Plate band was authored, it is not a plate.

movements.name: ASCENSION
movements.what: How the site learned to think, and then to speak.
movements.note: Sixteen chapters in four acts, prologue included. Opens in medias res on failure and ends at a threshold deliberately uncrossed.

movements.name: THE LONG CLIMB
movements.what: The threshold crossed. The helix, and the black heart of Page 2.
movements.note: The one movement that is finished — typeset and illustrated. It also spans the UNDOCUMENTED PERIOD: no briefs before 29 June.

movements.name: THE SIEGE
movements.what: Three days. The gates were not breached — they were read.
movements.source: The Siege.html — 6,651 words, nine books plus a field journal
movements.note: The gates were closed by TIME, not an enemy. You cannot out-fight time, only outwork it — which is why the fleet is instruments rather than warships.

movements.name: THE SHIP
movements.what: Registers, probes, watches, the ark. The system becomes readable.

chapters.title: The Beach
chapters.blurb: A man comes out of the sea holding the only object that can release a thousand souls, and what he wants is a cheeseburger.
chapters.why: THE FRAME, and it belongs to no movement — what he reads is all four. Opened once and never closed. The last human scene in the work, and the one chapter with no apparatus because it makes no claim a probe could check.

chapters.title: The Sound of a Sawmill
chapters.blurb: Parler-TTS in a Colab notebook producing a grinding mechanical roar instead of a voice. The dream of a speaking library, and the wall.
chapters.why: WRITE THIS FIRST — the author's own build order: lock the tone before proceeding. Ends on the question that reframes everything: what if one machine was never meant to both think and speak? Needs the 19 June transcript.

chapters.title: The Library of the Dead
chapters.blurb: What Amenti is and why. The roster of eleven hundred. The constraint that became a philosophy: variety is the magic, not accuracy.

chapters.title: A Mind in a Box
chapters.blurb: Claude as the cognition layer, the Worker as broker. First contact: a historical figure answering in character.
chapters.why: The first code scene — the proxy, and the system prompt that makes a figure BE the figure.

chapters.title: The Paradigm Shift
chapters.blurb: Cognition and voice are different faculties and must be sequenced like a brain, not braided.
chapters.why: THE HINGE OF THE WHOLE WORK. A mind, a voice, one nervous system — do not braid them.

chapters.title: The First Word
chapters.blurb: The first time a figure speaks. The discovery that nearly did not happen.

chapters.title: Direction, Not Cloning
chapters.blurb: Convincing accents from a STYLE string, without cloning. An actor that takes stage direction.
chapters.why: The moment cloning became unnecessary.

chapters.title: The Vault
chapters.blurb: Amenti becomes a publisher, not a chat machine. Generate once, cache forever.
chapters.why: The economic insight planted here pays off in the cost wall three movements later.

chapters.title: The Sawmill, Redeemed
chapters.blurb: Why the dead end was necessary. It cleared the ground for the hosted-faculty architecture.
chapters.why: Callback to the prologue. Owning versus brokering.

chapters.title: The Five Columns
chapters.blurb: The voice-identity schema. Gender, Dialect, Voice, Region, Location. Designing for where you are going.

chapters.title: The Casting of Eleven Hundred
chapters.blurb: The rejected hash engine — Shakespeare comes out female, Dante speaks Arabic — and the pivot to knowledge-based casting.
chapters.why: A genuine failure scene. Failure scenes are kept, not hidden.

chapters.title: Two Loaders, One Soul
chapters.blurb: Two pages, two completely different roster loaders. The migration, and the architecture wisely not unified.

chapters.title: The Wall of Money
chapters.blurb: The 429. The free-tier quota. Bounded downside, unbounded upside.

chapters.title: Charles Martel Speaks in a Woman's Voice
chapters.blurb: A small-stakes mystery that teaches the whole composition system. The bug, the hunt, the fix.
chapters.why: Ends with figures finally speaking as themselves across every surface.

chapters.title: The Architect Enters the Library
chapters.blurb: Ian Ingram added to the curated roster beside Cromwell. The creator becomes one of the legends.
chapters.why: A quiet, resonant beat.

chapters.title: The Handoff
chapters.blurb: The system documented, banked, handed off. A private build becomes a transferable thing.
chapters.why: Ascension status reached: it thinks, it publishes, it speaks.

chapters.title: The Last Threshold
chapters.blurb: The chunked-audio dilemma, and the realisation that this is how speech itself works.
chapters.why: ENDS UNCROSSED, deliberately. The next movement opens by crossing it — a stronger join than a resolution.

chapters.title: The Chunking Dilemma
chapters.blurb: Two days back. The threshold Ascension left uncrossed, crossed.
chapters.why: WRITTEN — in Book_of_Amenti.html. Needs setting, not composing.

chapters.title: One Engine, Many Surfaces
chapters.blurb: The unmaking of duplicates. Four TTS engines become one.
chapters.why: WRITTEN.

chapters.title: The Doctrine
chapters.blurb: The rules of the soul.
chapters.why: WRITTEN.

chapters.title: The Guardians
chapters.blurb: Lanterns on the wall.
chapters.why: WRITTEN.

chapters.title: The Proxy
chapters.blurb: The engine wakes its ears.
chapters.why: WRITTEN.

chapters.title: The Black Heart of Page 2
chapters.blurb: The double helix, the Axis of Truth, and a scene dying at four frames a second.
chapters.why: WRITTEN. It describes the UNDOCUMENTED PERIOD — April and May, no briefs — and the reader can go and look: the helix is live on the Interface tab. A chapter written from memory pointing at something that is not memory. CAUTION: a link is a claim.

chapters.title: The Siege of Amenti
chapters.blurb: A midnight raid on the Fourth of July, the gates breached, and a docket that had seeded itself.
chapters.why: WRITTEN THAT WEEK — 6,651 words, nine books. A primary source, not a brief to be adapted, and it must not be smoothed. OPEN: how much goes in.

chapters.title: The Specification
chapters.blurb: A hundred and ninety spells, each named and numbered and invoked to pass a gate. That is a function signature.
chapters.why: The first chapter through the full apparatus. Its Plate reads spell-conformance.json.

chapters.title: The Three Refusals
chapters.blurb: Amenti refuses loss. Hades refuses memory, and holds the court. Valhalla refuses return.
chapters.why: A key that only opens is decoration.

chapters.title: The Manifest of the Fleet
chapters.blurb: Every file and its office — and the twenty-six that no manifest named.
chapters.why: Band two reads fleet-manifest.js.

chapters.title: The Keyring
chapters.blurb: Four conventions and none of them written down. A key is not wrong until a second soul answers to it.
chapters.why: Band two reads KEYS.json.

chapters.title: The Two Ghosts
chapters.blurb: A moment mistaken for a man, and a man split into two ghosts.
chapters.why: Band two reads PLATES.json. Authority is what makes error possible.

chapters.title: The Water Between
chapters.blurb: Six registers, each perfect about its own island, and every fault living in the water between them.
chapters.why: Band two reads CHART.json.

chapters.title: The Ark
chapters.blurb: A backup that was never read back is not a backup. It is a file with a hopeful name.
chapters.why: Band two reads ARK.json.

chapters.title: The Weighing
chapters.blurb: The court convenes in a hall nobody sees, decides, records, and is gone.
chapters.why: BLOCKED. The bell has rung by hand and it has been registered for the wrong day. It has not yet rung correctly and unattended.

open: Volume grouping. Four movements are a FACT; volumes are packaging, and the material is not fully inventoried. Decide after the inventory.
The store's front matter claims the same apparatus in every chapter. True of one movement. Redrafted in BOOKSTORE-FRONT-MATTER-DRAFT.md.
Three prose voices — mythic, field chronicle, and Movement I unwritten. Unify or keep distinct?
The April–May gap. No briefs before 29 June.
